Type: chair
Name: Stone & Beam Westport Modern Nailhead Upholstered Accent Arm Chair, 36"W, Stone Brown
Colors: Stone Brown
Materials: stone
Elevate your style with this head-turning modern chair. The deep seat is combined with a down-blend back cushion that is reversible. Nailhead trim on the arms and across the sides, along with the exposed wood base, adds extra sophistication. 36"W x 37.75''D x  33''H Durable polyester fabric; metal nailhead trim; wood legs. Removable, reversible back cushion enhances durability. No assembly required. Vacuum or wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
